'''Krau''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Tormen]]. Krau was sent by Tormen with his troops to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to help with the [[Battle of Corellia|battle there]], and collaborated with the [[Hunter (individual)|Tormen's hunter]] on several missions.
